availability: R and earlier only, available_at=B1 start; max_feature_source_row=R row

features.L: Known maximal adjacent non-doji leg length; R excluded; segment-start legs undefined.
features.R_duration_seconds: B1 start-R start; zero duration retained with undefined pace flag.
features.chop10: switches/non-doji adjacent pairs in prior 10 physical bars.
features.chop20: switches/non-doji adjacent pairs in prior 20 physical bars.
features.previous_leg_1: Length of 1th completed known non-doji leg before immediate prior leg; missing across barriers/unknown starts.
features.previous_leg_2: Length of 2th completed known non-doji leg before immediate prior leg; missing across barriers/unknown starts.
features.previous_leg_3: Length of 3th completed known non-doji leg before immediate prior leg; missing across barriers/unknown starts.
features.prior_counter_wick_fraction: mean lower wick/span for bullish prior leg, upper for bearish.
features.prior_direction_wick_fraction: mean upper wick/span for bullish prior leg, lower for bearish.
features.prior_distance_q: prior direction * (last close - first open) / q.
features.prior_duration_seconds: R start minus first prior-leg start.
features.prior_efficiency: abs(last close-first open)/(abs(first close-first open)+sum(abs(adjacent closes))).
features.prior_overlap: mean intersection/min(span) across adjacent prior bars; L=1 undefined.
features.recent20_efficiency: abs(last prior close-first of 20 open)/(abs(first body)+sum(abs(adjacent closes))).
features.recent20_tr_q: median max(span,abs(high-prevC),abs(low-prevC)) on prior 20 bars/q; 21 bars required.

missing: NaN/nullable values, plus explicit undefined_<name> flags; no zero imputation in evidence
prices: all classifications, differences and grids exact int64 at 1e-9; ratios converted only after exact arithmetic
